## Evolution of Graph Databases in the Past Year
The evolution of graph databases in the past year can be summarized as follows:
* **Increased efficiency in resolving complicated challenges**: Graph databases have evolved to the point where they are capable of resolving some of the more complicated challenges of the telecommunications industry.
* **Growing use of AI and machine learning**: Combating fraud has become a high priority, with AI and machine learning becoming the first choice to stay ahead of threats.
* **Improved user-friendliness**: Graph databases have evolved to the point of being user-friendly, allowing the full strength of their abilities to predict patterns to be explored.
* **Advancements in predicting patterns**: The strengths of graph databases will continue to be explored and advanced, with a focus on predicting patterns.
* **Emergence as a replacement for RDBMS**: The future of RDBMS will certainly be the Graph Databases with NoSql methodologies, which is emerging as beyond the relational model.

Sources:
* [Graph Databases: Benefits and Best Practices - DATAVERSITY](https://www.dataversity.net/graph-databases-best-practices-and-new-developments/)
* [Graph Databases: Updates on Their Growing Popularity](https://www.dataversity.net/graph-databases-updates-on-their-growing-popularity/)
* [Graph Database: A Survey | IEEE Conference Publication - IEEE Xplore](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/9223105)
